projects.name: mlkem-native (pq-code-package)
projects.baselines: reference C ML-KEM (pq-crystals/kyber ref), liboqs portable C
projects.lead: SLOTHY-optimised AArch64 and x86-64 kernels with HOL-Light proofs, default in liboqs 0.13.0 and AWS-LC; the README and docs carry cycle tables vs the C reference; record with CPU.

projects.name: aes-armcortexm (bitsliced Cortex-M AES, Ko-)
projects.baselines: reference C AES, mbedTLS AES on Cortex-M
projects.lead: Credited by aadomn/aes for its S-box code; README cycle counts vs C implementations on Cortex-M3/M4.

projects.name: FreeBSD libmd md5block.S (amd64 MD5 kernels)
projects.baselines: the C MD5 in libmd, OpenSSL MD5
projects.lead: lib/libmd/amd64/md5block.S (baseline, BMI1 and AVX-512 kernels); Phabricator D45670 holds the numbers (reviews.freebsd.org may be blocked; the commit message in the repo quotes them). Record the kernel as the component.

projects.name: leancrypto (smuellerDD) RISC-V ML-KEM assembly
projects.baselines: leancrypto's own C ML-KEM, reference C
projects.lead: Issue #2 cites ML-KEM-1024 about 60% faster on a SpacemiT X60 with the PQRV RISC-V assembly; record the issue numbers and any bench tables in the repo.

projects.name: lazypoline (syscall interposition, lazypoline/lazypoline)
projects.lead: DSN 2024; exhaustive SUD plus lazy binary rewriting; the repo's benchmarks directory compares against zpoline; record syscall latency rows.

projects.name: Souper (LLVM IR superoptimizer, google/souper)
projects.lead: Minotaur's predecessor; the arXiv 1711.04422 paper (blocked) reports speedups on SPEC; use README or in-repo docs; D if no numbers reachable.

projects.name: parasail (SIMD pairwise alignment library, jeffdaily)
projects.lead: BMC Bioinformatics 2016 paper tables; the repo README and wiki carry throughput numbers vs SSW; record flags and CPU.

projects.name: ksw2 (lh3)
projects.lead: README timing table (ksw2 vs parasail and others on the same input); record it with the stated CPU.

projects.name: WFA2-lib (wavefront alignment, smarco)
projects.lead: Bioinformatics 2021/2023 papers; the repo README and benchmark folder compare against ksw2 and edlib; record with flags.

projects.name: libstats (OldCrow)
projects.baselines: libm (exp, log, erf, sin, cos), corvus
projects.lead: corvus issue #43 says libstats is faster on M1; record the repo's own benchmark tables vs libm or corvus; D if none.

projects.name: space-pruner (ARM NEON despacing, DerekScottLedbetter)
projects.lead: Despacer's closest relative; README numbers vs the scalar loop; record CPU.

projects.name: bolt (dblalock)

projects.lead: KDD 2017 paper; README '10x faster' AVX2 PQ-style scan; MPL-2.0, 2.5k stars; record the paper or README rows against FAISS or BLAS with flags.
